---
title: "Persistent run manager"
output: html_notebook
---

Shared utilities for allocating persistent run IDs, attaching notebooks to
an existing run, and organizing run-specific outputs.

Master notebook allocates a new run ID. Stages attach to that run and use a
common directory structure and filename suffix.

The save helpers reject existing output paths so rerunning a stage does not
silently replace artifacts saved through these helpers.

## Run allocation and artifact paths

The persistent counter is stored in `outputs/run_counter.txt`.
Each run receives a directory such as `outputs/run_0001`, with artifact
filenames suffixed `_run_0001`, `_run_0002`, and so on for tracking.

The calling workflow must define `project_root` before loading this file
and assign `run_context <- attach_run()` before using the artifact helpers.

```{r run-allocation-and-artifact-paths}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared output location
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Keep all run directories and run-tracking files under the project outputs.
# Loading this file creates the parent directory if it does not already exist.
run_root <- file.path(project_root, "outputs")

dir.create(
    run_root,
    showWarnings = FALSE,
    recursive = TRUE
)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# New-run allocation
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Allocate one new persistent run ID for a master-notebook execution.
# Stage notebooks should attach to this run rather than allocate their own.
start_new_run <- function() {
    counter_file <- file.path(run_root, "run_counter.txt")
    lock_directory <- file.path(run_root, ".run_counter_lock")

    # Use a lock directory to prevent cooperating processes from allocating
    # the counter at the same time. Stop rather than wait for an existing lock.
    if (!dir.create(lock_directory, showWarnings = FALSE)) {
        stop(
            "A run counter lock exists. ",
            "Verify no other run is active before removing it."
        )
    }

    # Release the allocation lock when the function exits normally or errors.
    # An abruptly terminated R process can still leave a stale lock behind.
    on.exit(
        unlink(lock_directory, recursive = TRUE),
        add = TRUE
    )

    # Read the previous counter, or start at zero for the first run.
    # Only the first line of an existing counter file is used.
    old <- if (file.exists(counter_file)) {
        suppressWarnings(
            as.integer(readLines(counter_file, warn = FALSE))
        )
    } else {
        0L
    }

    # Reject a missing, unreadable, or negative counter before allocating.
    if (length(old) != 1L || is.na(old) || old < 0L) {
        stop("Invalid run counter; inspect outputs/run_counter.txt")
    }

    # Use at least four digits so run names have consistent padding.
    number <- old + 1L
    run_id <- sprintf("%04d", number)

    run_directory <- file.path(
        run_root,
        paste0("run_", run_id)
    )

    # Do not reuse an existing run directory, even if the counter points to it.
    if (dir.exists(run_directory)) {
        stop("Run folder already exists: ", run_directory)
    }

    dir.create(
        run_directory,
        recursive = TRUE,
        showWarnings = FALSE
    )

    # Stage the new counter value in a temporary file before copying it
    # into place. The allocation lock remains held throughout this update.
    tmp <- tempfile(tmpdir = run_root)
    writeLines(as.character(number), tmp)

    if (!file.copy(tmp, counter_file, overwrite = TRUE)) {
        unlink(tmp)
        stop("Unable to update the run counter")
    }

    unlink(tmp)

    # Record the active run on disk for notebooks without an environment ID.
    writeLines(
        run_id,
        file.path(run_root, "active_run.txt")
    )

    # Make the run ID available in this process and inherited environments.
    # attach_run() checks this value before consulting active_run.txt.
    Sys.setenv(ATG_RUN_ID = run_id)

    return(run_id)
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Attachment to an existing run
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Resolve the current run and create its standard output subdirectories.
# This function does not allocate a new counter value.
attach_run <- function() {
    run_id <- Sys.getenv("ATG_RUN_ID", unset = "")

    # Prefer an explicitly inherited run ID.
    # Otherwise, fall back to the shared active-run file.
    if (!nzchar(run_id)) {
        active <- file.path(run_root, "active_run.txt")

        if (!file.exists(active)) {
            stop(
                "No run is active. ",
                "Start notebooks/00_Run_All.Rmd first."
            )
        }

        run_id <- trimws(
            readLines(active, warn = FALSE)
        )
    }

    # Accept only numeric identifiers with at least four digits.
    if (!grepl("^[0-9]{4,}$", run_id)) {
        stop("Invalid run identifier: ", run_id)
    }

    base <- file.path(
        run_root,
        paste0("run_", run_id)
    )

    # Attaching must not silently create a previously unallocated run.
    if (!dir.exists(base)) {
        stop("Run directory does not exist: ", base)
    }

    # Return one shared context containing the ID and output locations.
    folders <- list(
        id = run_id,
        root = base,
        tables = file.path(base, "tables"),
        figures = file.path(base, "figures"),
        models = file.path(base, "models"),
        checkpoints = file.path(base, "checkpoints"),
        notebooks = file.path(base, "notebooks"),
        logs = file.path(base, "logs")
    )

    # Create directory entries only; the ID is metadata, not a path.
    for (path in unlist(folders[names(folders) != "id"])) {
        dir.create(
            path,
            recursive = TRUE,
            showWarnings = FALSE
        )
    }

    folders
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Run-specific artifact paths
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Build a filename using the current run's shared suffix.
# The caller must first assign run_context <- attach_run().
artifact_path <- function(area, stem, extension = "rds") {
    if (!area %in% names(run_context)) {
        stop("Unknown output category: ", area)
    }

    file.path(
        run_context[[area]],
        sprintf(
            "%s_run_%s.%s",
            stem,
            run_context$id,
            extension
        )
    )
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RDS artifact saving
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Save an R object without intentionally replacing an existing artifact.
# Repeated stage execution must use a new run rather than mix saved results.
save_once_rds <- function(object, area, stem) {
    path <- artifact_path(area, stem)

    if (file.exists(path)) {
        stop(
            "This stage already saved ",
            path,
            ". Start a NEW run to avoid mixed results."
        )
    }

    # Serialize to a temporary file before copying to the final destination.
    # Clean up the temporary file on both success and ordinary error exits.
    temp_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")

    on.exit(
        unlink(temp_file),
        add = TRUE
    )

    saveRDS(object, temp_file)

    # Refuse to overwrite a destination that already exists at copy time.
    if (!file.copy(temp_file, path, overwrite = FALSE)) {
        stop("Failed to save ", path)
    }

    # Compare byte counts as a basic completeness check.
    # A matching size is not a full content-integrity verification.
    if (file.size(path) != file.size(temp_file)) {
        unlink(path)
        stop("Incomplete output copy removed: ", path)
    }

    invisible(path)
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RDS artifact loading
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Load an artifact from the attached run only.
# Stop with its expected path when an earlier stage has not produced it.
load_run_rds <- function(area, stem) {
    path <- artifact_path(area, stem)

    if (!file.exists(path)) {
        stop("Previous notebook output missing: ", path)
    }

    readRDS(path)
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Table export
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Export a table as a run-specific CSV.
# Write missing values as empty fields and reject an existing output path.
save_table <- function(data, stem) {
    path <- artifact_path("tables", stem, "csv")

    if (file.exists(path)) {
        stop("Table already exists: ", path)
    }

    data.table::fwrite(
        data.table::as.data.table(data),
        path,
        na = ""
    )

    invisible(path)
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Figure display and export
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Explicitly print the plot so it appears when called from notebook code.
# Then export a run-specific PNG using dimensions in inches and 160 dpi.
show_and_save <- function(plot, stem, width = 9, height = 5) {
    print(plot)

    path <- artifact_path("figures", stem, "png")

    if (file.exists(path)) {
        stop("Figure already exists: ", path)
    }

    ggplot2::ggsave(
        path,
        plot = plot,
        width = width,
        height = height,
        dpi = 160
    )

    invisible(path)
}
```
